Polynomial ODE continuous dependence plus reflection establishes both Riccati limits for fixed \(t\) unequal to \(t_*\). Rescaled monotone quadratures converge locally uniformly to the inverse integral of exp(v^2), proving the profile. The 22 executable diagnostic assertions check, but do not replace, these analytic steps.

value.rationale: The exchange-equals-self-reaction surface is a natural dynamical boundary: on the homoclinic side all positive orbits return to the origin, but at equality unbalanced data blow up at a finite Riccati time. The exponential excursion height, sharply corrected peak clock, species-exchange continuation and universal inverse-erfi pulse profile rigorously quantify this nonuniform transition. The balanced-data widening regime shows precisely why the blow-up approximation cannot be uniformly extrapolated across initial compositions. The result concerns a natural physical-time invariant rather than an arbitrary slice or textbook first-integral exercise.
